title: SEIS Goal Tracking Update Orchestrator
purpose: Update the file-backed Goal Tracking OS from inspected repository evidence without inventing progress, expanding scope silently, or requiring a monolithic prompt body.

characterBudget.reason: The prompt engine already defines a bounded rendered prompt contract. The five-million-character request is recorded as an upper context budget, not as permission to add filler or duplicate source documents.

chunks.responsibility: Establish project identity, authority order, Apple-first boundaries, public/private status, and the active goal namespace.
chunks.output: A bounded execution context and a list of source records that are allowed to change.

chunks.responsibility: Select the highest-priority unblocked goal, preserve its status vocabulary, define non-goals, dependencies, risks, acceptance criteria, and rollback.
chunks.output: A small goal update plan linked to an existing canonical goal id.

chunks.responsibility: Map implementation work to evidence, execution records, reviewer ownership, and explicit blockers. Do not turn plans into completed work.
chunks.output: Evidence-backed task and handoff records with limitations.

chunks.responsibility: Check architecture, AI Core, provider, model, agent, MCP, tool, skill, security, and approval boundaries before proposing a change.
chunks.output: A risk-aware change boundary and a bounded delegation plan.

chunks.responsibility: Implement only the scoped change, run the relevant real checks, and record failed or skipped checks without replacing them with claims.
chunks.output: Changed files, exact validation commands, results, and residual risk.

chunks.responsibility: Reconcile goal, roadmap, PR queue, status, evidence, next action, and maturity without overwriting unrelated user work.
chunks.output: A consistent source record or an explicit follow-up goal for remaining work.

chunks.responsibility: Verify secrets, private content, provider calls, external mutation, deployment, SSH, and background execution claims remain outside the allowed boundary.
chunks.output: Security notes, approval requirements, and a rollback statement.

chunks.responsibility: Prepare a concise handoff containing goal status, evidence, risks, blockers, next recommended goal, GitHub output, and the exact repository-state line.
chunks.output: A reviewable run summary; never a claim of work that happened outside the active environment.

forbiddenClaims: persistent agents after the session stops
unverified build, test, deployment, or integration success
